prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE square production atlas EXACTLY 4 COLUMNS x4 ROWS of SIXTEEN distinct educational papercraft vignettes about CLUBFOOT (pied bot varus equin) and its orthopaedic care. Show artificial anatomical TEACHING MODELS of feet, lower legs and orthotic devices only. No full human bodies, no babies, no fetuses, no real clinical photographs, no blood, no wounds, no surgery. Rich physically handmade thick layered fibrous cardstock, warm light and tiny contact shadows, moss/sage, ivory, peach, dusty blue, ochre, coral and lavender. Each illustration completely inside its equal cell with broad genuinely transparent gutters; no overlap. Exact row-major scenes: 1. schematic orthopaedic model of a foot turned inward, isolated below-knee segment, thick peach and ivory paper; 2. three small views of the same foot showing inward heel tilt, plantar-flexed ankle and inward forefoot, simple arrows, no text; 3. two small foot silhouettes linked by a simple family-tree pattern, representing familial predisposition without people; 4. two simplified ivory foot skeleton alignment models, normal and congenital inward alignment, no biological specimens; 5. ivory talus and hindfoot model with changed alignment, clear non-graphic teaching diagram; 6. side-view lower-leg and foot mannequin model with shortened Achilles tendon ribbon pulling heel upward; 7. front and rear views of inward-turned foot model, no injury or wound; 8. foot model resting on outer edge instead of sole, beside its curved footprint; 9. blue-gloved hands holding a foot mannequin to assess passive correction, only hands and foot; 10. simple foot X-ray plate beside foot-bone model, no writing; 11. sequence of three removable plaster casts around artificial foot-and-lower-leg models, no procedure, no people; 12. empty orthopaedic abduction brace with two small boots and connecting bar, beside a blank calendar; 13. corrected plantigrade foot model resting flat on ground beside a normal footprint; 14. residual inward alignment of foot model compared with neutral foot, neutral educational depiction; 15. magnifying glass examining alignment of a foot model and footprint, no writing; 16. empty boot-and-bar foot orthosis beside repeated blank calendar squares, representing long-term follow-up. All images non-graphic, calm and schematic. No letters, labels, words, numbers, logos or screenshots. Preserve strict4x4 equal-cell grid and true transparent alpha outside all16 independent vignettes.
